baseline.method: Independent Qopen run on all 25 event-frequency inversions

metric_definition: Maximum absolute natural log of positive estimate/reference; no alignment. Site gauge is geometric mean 1 over valid slots. Forward weighted log-energy residual uses coda unit weights, bulk sample-count weight and N-S-1 denominator.
threshold_provenance: Tightened within frozen preimplementation 0.02 log-ratio bound; original double-precision repeat and float32-output sensitivity independently measured in private stability record. Forward limits are 1.05 times native error plus 0.001, fixed before Judge.
